commitMessage:
Replay: per-trip history tab and typed time range

Trips tab ('Perjalanan'):
- Pick a device and a day (today, yesterday or a date in WIB) to list
  that day's trips from the server's trip report, each as a card with
  times, duration, distance, max speed and from -> to
- Places use the geofence name when the start / end point lies in a
  geofence, otherwise the address (or coordinates)
- Parking time between trips is shown; tapping a card plays that trip
  with the existing player, with previous / next trip and back to list
- Chips tell whether the device reports ignition (ACC) and whether trip
  detection uses ACC or movement, with an (i) explaining the 5-minute
  default stop threshold

By time tab ('Waktu'):
- Start and end of the range can be typed as date + time (WIB); the
  range slider follows, snapping to the nearest recorded points
